features.name: Project Setup & Verification
features.description: Decide tech stack, scaffold the application, and make ./init.sh run real verification from a clean checkout. Harness files (AGENTS.md, feature_list.json, progress.md, init.sh, session-handoff.md) are already in place.
features.evidence: Stack locked via grill-with-docs (FastAPI + React + shadcn/ui; SQLite dev -> Postgres prod). Skeleton scaffolded 2026-08-18: backend FastAPI health API + pytest (1 passed); frontend Vite 8 / React 19 / TS 6 / Tailwind 4 + shadcn config. ./init.sh runs real verification in WSL (Ubuntu): backend pytest PASS, frontend typecheck CLEAN, production build OK. WSL toolchain: node 24.19.0, npm 11.17.0, uv 0.12.5, python 3.14.4.

features.name: AI Provider Integration (DeepSeek V4 Flash)
features.description: Configure DeepSeek V4 Flash (0731) as the AI provider for the standardized patient dialogue and scoring/feedback. API key supplied via environment variable by the user (registered separately). No hardcoded credentials.

features.name: Case Data Model & Developer Seed Workflow
features.description: Case data structure per requirements section 9 (Case, PatientInformation, ExaminerPack, CaseReviewRecord). Phase-1 cases are authored by developers as structured files (no web form, per decision 2026-08-18) and loaded via a seed/import script. First seed case: Cecilia (GP-ChestPain-0001).

features.name: Student & Teacher Login
features.description: Account login for students and teachers (first-phase requirement 3.1). No campus SSO in phase 1.

features.name: Practice Case List
features.description: Students see the list of practiceable published cases and can enter a CCE station.

features.name: CCE Station Flow Shell
features.description: Section-by-section CCE practice flow: student instruction -> history taking -> case presentation -> structured questions -> scoring/feedback. Sequential order only, no going back, resume after mid-way exit, per-section language rules (no mixed languages in one section).

features.name: AI Standardized Patient (History Taking)
features.description: Student asks history questions in text; AI plays the patient only, answering from the case script. Never gives diagnosis/answers/scoring points, never fabricates examination or investigation results.

features.name: Case Presentation Input
features.description: Student submits a case presentation in the language configured for that section.

features.name: Structured Questions & Investigation Reveal
features.description: One-by-one structured questions (diagnostic + management reasoning). Student-request-driven physical exam / investigation result reveal matched against the case item library; unconfigured items show 'not provided'; revealed results stay pinned for later questions.

features.name: AI Scoring, Feedback & Reference Answers
features.description: AI gives a practice reference score and feedback from the rubric; student sees reference answers and teaching explanations after completion. No formal score when the case has no rubric.

features.name: Teacher Dashboard (Basic Completion Stats)
features.description: Teachers can view basic practice completion status. No manual grading, no score override, no long-term per-student history in phase 1.

features.name: Future: Voice Input
features.description: Student voice input / transcription. Recorded as a phase-2 extension; NOT implemented in phase 1. Skeleton must not couple the chat UI to audio (no half-built features).
features.evidence: Recorded 2026-08-18 per user decision Q19; ADR to be written with final stack confirmation.

features.name: Future: Exam Mode & Countdown
features.description: Timed mode with countdown, random question selection, formal score statistics. Recorded as a phase-2 extension; NOT implemented in phase 1.

features.name: Future: Batch Case Import
features.description: Batch Excel/JSON import of cases. Recorded as a phase-2 extension; NOT implemented in phase 1 (developer-led structured-file entry + seed script instead).
